title: Workflows: Events, Tasks and Outcomes | Orchard Core
description:
A workflow can look like boxes and lines until you know what each box is. Orchard Core workflows are built from three things: events that start a workflow or make it wait, tasks that do the work, and outcomes that connect one activity to the next.

This video builds a small workflow in the designer that reacts to a published page, and explains each building block on the way.

In this video:
• The building blocks: events, tasks and outcomes
• Start with an event: create a workflow and add a Content Published Event
• Outcomes and connections: add a Fork Task and name its outcomes
• Tasks: add a Notify Task and a Log Task, and connect them
• Publish and run: publish the workflow, publish a page, and check the instance
